body.p: Claims 1-13 will be pending after entry of the present paper. Claims 1-13 were

previously pending. No claims are canceled by the present paper, and no new claims are added. Claims 1 and 10 are amended as set forth above. Applicant requests reconsideration of the present application in light of the following remarks.
The Office Action, p. 2, objects to claims 1 and 10. Without conceding that the
objections are proper and in the interest of furthering prosecutions, claims 1 and 10 have been amended. Applicant requests that the objections to claims 1 and 10 be withdrawn.
Claims 1-13 stand rejected on the ground of non-statutory double patenting over claims 1-20 of U.S. Patent No. 9,974,446 ("the '446 patent").
Claims 1-13 stand rejected on the ground of non-statutory double patenting over claims 1-21 of U.S. Patent No. 10,932,678 ("the '678 patent").
Claims 1-13 stand rejected on the ground of non-statutory double patenting over claims 1-13 of U.S. Patent No. 11,759,113 ("the '113 patent").
Without conceding that the rejections are proper and in the interest of furthering

prosecution, Applicant is submitting herewith terminal disclaimers with respect to the '446 patent, the '678 patent, and the '113 patent. Applicant requests that the double patenting rejections of claims 1-13 be withdrawn.

It is believed that all matters set forth in the Office Action have been addressed and that all of the pending claims are in condition for allowance. Accordingly, issuance of a formal Notice of Allowance is respectfully requested.

The Office Action contains characterizations of the claims and the cited references to which Applicant does not necessarily agree. Unless expressly noted otherwise, Applicant declines to subscribe to any statement or characterization in this or any other Office Action.

Should the Examiner deem that an interview with Applicant's undersigned attorney would further prosecution, the Examiner is invited to call the undersigned attorney at the telephone number indicated below.
Respectfully submitted, / Kelvin L. Varghese /Kelvin L. Varghese
